events.name: walkinfo_touch
events.onresize: if(stagewidth GT stageheight, set(layer[walkinfo_touch], align=rightbottom, x=80, y=40); , set(layer[walkinfo_touch], align=bottom, x=50, y=50); );

hotspot.name: car
hotspot.color.onchange: set_car_material('Ст 09Г2С ГОСТ19281-80.005*', get(color), get(roughness), get(metalness), null, null, 1.0, 0.05);
hotspot.metalness.onchange: set_car_material('Ст 09Г2С ГОСТ19281-80.005*', get(color), get(roughness), get(metalness), null, null, 1.0, 0.05);
hotspot.roughness.onchange: set_car_material('Ст 09Г2С ГОСТ19281-80.005*', get(color), get(roughness), get(metalness), null, null, 1.0, 0.05);
hotspot.clearcoat.onchange: set_car_material('Ст 09Г2С ГОСТ19281-80.005*', get(color), get(roughness), get(metalness), null, null, get(clearcoat), 0.05);
hotspot.clearcoatRoughness.onchange: set_car_material('Ст 09Г2С ГОСТ19281-80.005*', get(color), get(roughness), get(metalness), null, null, 1.0, get(clearcoatRoughness));
hotspot.rimscolor.onchange: set_car_material('Mtl', get(rimscolor), 0.5, 0.0); set_car_material('Mtl4*', get(rimscolor), 0.5, 0.0); set_car_material('Mtl3*', get(rimscolor), 0.5, 0.0); set_car_material('Mtl1*', get(rimscolor), 0.5, 0.0); set_car_material('Mtl6*', get(rimscolor), 0.5, 0.0); set_car_material('Mtl5*', get(rimscolor), 0.5, 0.0);

layer.onclick: control.invert=false; tween(hotspot[car].windowtint,0.1); adjusthlookat(get(view_car.hlookat)); tween(get(view), get(view_car), 1.0, smooth, view.limitview='auto';);
control.invert=false; tween(hotspot[car].windowtint,0.6); adjusthlookat(get(view_walk.hlookat)); tween(get(view), get(view_walk), 1.0, smooth, view.limitview='auto';);

control.invert=true; tween(hotspot[car].windowtint,0.6); adjusthlookat(get(view_model.hlookat)); tween(get(view), get(view_model), 1.0, smooth, view.limitview='lookat'; view.vlookatmin=-5; view.vlookatmax=90;);
